LockHint.Soft: Players get your value once and can change it afterwards.
LockHint.Player: Players are kept on the locked value. You keep your own.
LockHint.Hard: Everyone, including you, is kept on the locked value.

Tooltip.SoftLockedByGM: The GM suggested this value. You can change it.

Conflict.BannerText: Carolingian UI's "Enable client settings lock for core and other modules" is enabled alongside Nik's Settings Locks. To prevent duplicate icons and desynchronized enforcement, please disable it.
Conflict.ResolvedNotification: Disabled Carolingian UI generic locks. Nik's Settings Locks is managing your settings locks.
Conflict.ReadyWarn: Carolingian UI's generic settings lock is enabled. This conflicts with Nik's Settings Locks. Open the Lock Manager or Configure Settings to resolve it.

Notifications.HardLockBlocked: Cannot change "{name}" — it is locked by the GM.
Notifications.PlayerLockBlocked: Cannot change "{name}" — the GM has locked it for players.
Notifications.ReloadForcing: Some locked settings require a reload to take effect. Reloading now…
Notifications.LocksEnforced: Locks have been updated by the GM.
Notifications.SoftLocksReenforcedOne: Re-sent {count} suggested value. Connected players get it now, others when they next log in.
Notifications.SoftLocksReenforcedMany: Re-sent {count} suggested values. Connected players get them now, others when they next log in.
Notifications.NoSoftLocks: There are no suggested values to re-send.
Notifications.NoActiveGM: A GM must be logged in to save lock changes.

Prompt.SoftDesc: You changed settings or controls that have a suggested value for players. Ticked items send your new value to players. Unticked items only change for you.
Prompt.SoftCheckbox: Suggest the new value to players
Prompt.HardDesc: You changed settings or controls that are locked for everyone, so they also apply to you. Ticked items update the locked value for everyone. Unticked items are changed back to the locked value.
Prompt.HardCheckbox: Update the locked value for everyone

Settings.OpenManagerHint: Opens a dedicated window for managing all settings and control locks.
Settings.MinRoleHint: The minimum user role required to view and manage locks. Higher roles are always included (e.g. selecting Trusted Player also grants access to Assistant GMs and Game Masters).
